worldcombat.skill.scratch.summary: One passing rake opens a row of parallel claw lines: raise a paw and drag it, each line cutting whatever it crosses; a wider foe standing closer is caught by more lines at once. The fastest and cheapest move of the family.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.use.0: Open a row of claw lines point-blank
worldcombat.skill.scratch.use.1: Catch a wide or lined-up foe with several lines at once
worldcombat.skill.scratch.use.2: Grind health with the cheapest, shortest-cooldown strike
worldcombat.skill.scratch.description.0: One rake draws %2$s claw lines, each dealing %1$s contact slashing damage; a target caught by several lines is hit several times.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.description.1: The lines reach %1$s blocks, spread over %2$s degrees, each %3$s blocks half-wide.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.sweep.on: Wide rake: %1$s lines over %2$s degrees catch a row or a broad foe, at the cost of %3$s power per line, a slightly shorter reach and a slower start and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.sweep.off: Straight rake: fewer but longer, heavier lines and a faster start, best for picking off one small target.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; start %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.growth.0: From level %1$s each claw line deepens to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.growth.1: From level %1$s each claw line deepens to %2$s and one rake draws %3$s lines.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.preference.swe: On: +2 claw lines over a wider arc, catching a row or a broad foe, at the cost of x0.86 power per line, a shorter reach and a slower start and cooldown. Off (straight rake): fewer, longer and heavier lines with a faster start, best for picking off one small target.
worldcombat.skill.scratch.approach: As you rake you close in up to %1$s blocks toward the target, stopping once the claw lines already reach it; each line strikes only the first target it crosses.
